subject: Approval request: Limited FISMA-scoped private deployment + pilot credit — Sentinel Health
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@sentinelhealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.reynolds@sentinelhealth.com
Date: 2028-05-09T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot requirements and contract asks (FISMA scope)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — the execs liked the latency profile on private hosting. Before we move to a pilot, a few mandatory constraints from our compliance team:

- Deployment must be scoped to FISMA Moderate control set (not full FedRAMP) for the pilot.
- Data egress from our VPC is disallowed; customer-managed KMS is required.
- Audit request: 2x 4-hour in-person/remote windows during the 90-day pilot; no continuous 3rd-party access.
- Contract ask: 30% pilot credit (applied to first 90 days) and a one-time dev/support credit if we hit the OKR milestones.

Can Redwood accommodate these? If not, what compromises are possible. I attached a draft SOW (Sentinel_SOW_v2.pdf) for context.

Best,
Elena

--
Elena Morales
Head of Platform Security, Sentinel Health
elena.morales@sentinelhealth.com
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@sentinelhealth.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-09T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot requirements and contract asks (FISMA scope)

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear summary and the SOW.

We can support a limited FISMA-moderate scoped deployment in a dedicated VPC for a timeboxed pilot. High-level responses:
- Customer-managed KMS: yes, we support external KMS/HSM integrations for the Private offering.
- Egress: we can restrict outbound egress and enable private peering; will confirm network gearbox details with infra.
- Audit windows: we can commit to two scheduled 4-hour audit sessions during the pilot. We will require predefined evidence bundles and an NDA addendum for any recorded sessions.
- Commercial: we can offer a pilot credit; need Deal Desk approval on percentage.

I'm looping in Marcus (VP Sales) for the commercial ask and Jordan for procurement coordination. Marcus — can you approve a timebound pilot credit and confirm process for an amendment?

I'll attach the SOW into our thread for visibility.

Thanks,
Kimberly

--
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Attachment: Sentinel_SOW_v2.pdf
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-10T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Sentinel Health — request for pilot credit + limited FISMA hosting approval (details below)

Team — forwarding Elena's asks and the SOW. Summary for Deal Desk / Exec:

Customer: Sentinel Health (growth-stage medtech)
Ask: 30% pilot credit (90 days), limited FISMA-moderate private deployment, customer KMS, two 4-hour audit windows, strict no-egress requirement.
Key risks: longer-term support cost if we need to maintain isolated stacks; potential infra uplift for strict egress controls; legal will need to sign an amendment with audit scope.
Proposed commercial compromise: 15% pilot credit + one-time $10k engineering/support credit for pilot (internal margin impact ~ 12%). This preserves our pricing while showing commitment.

Attached: Sentinel_SOW_v2.pdf, DataFlowDiagram.png
Requested approvals:
- Marcus: approval of 15% pilot credit + $10k support credit (temporary pilot concession)
- Jordan: coordinate amendment language with Legal (timebound audit windows, evidence bundles allowed, no broad continuous access)
- Neha: confirm security gating and whether the proposed controls meet FISMA-moderate acceptable baseline.

Can we get a decision by EOD tomorrow so we can respond to Elena?

Thanks,
Kimberly
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-10T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Sentinel Health — request for pilot credit + limited FISMA hosting approval (details below)

Kimberly — reviewed SOW and DataFlowDiagram. Quick notes from Sec/Compliance:

- KMS: customer-managed KMS/HSM is acceptable. We'll require an onboarding checklist and keys never leave customer's control; we need a KMS attestation clause.
- Egress: we can implement strict egress rules via VPC firewall + NAT restrictions. However, full zero-egress for telemetry and health metrics is difficult — we can redact telemetry and provide aggregated metrics to Sentinel.
- Audit windows: agreed to two scheduled 4-hour windows during pilot. We request that local log exports and an evidence bundle (hash-signed) be provided in advance of the windows to reduce real-time access.
- Additional ask: enable tokenization for PHI in transit and at rest for pilot (simple masking pipeline). That will add ~2 engineer-weeks if they want it in the pilot.

Conclusion: security can approve the limited FISMA-moderate pilot if: (a) customer accepts evidence-bundle + attestation approach for audit, (b) they accept masked telemetry rather than raw.

I attached our SOC2_summary_stub.pdf for reference to the customer (we can share a redacted summary).

-Neha

Attachment: SOC2_summary_stub.pdf
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-11T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Sentinel Health — request for pilot credit + limited FISMA hosting approval (decision)

Team — after reviewing margins and controls, I approve the following for the Sentinel Health pilot:

- Commercial concession: 15% pilot credit applied to first 90 days + one-time $10k engineering/support credit.
- Security carve: accept customer-managed KMS and the evidence-bundle approach for the two audit windows; agree to masked telemetry as Neha recommended.
- Network: approve timeboxed no-egress configuration with private peering; infra to document fail-open behavior.

Conditions: Legal must produce a short amendment that: (1) limits audit to two scheduled 4-hour sessions, (2) requires pre-shared evidence bundles and attestation, (3) includes the one-time support credit language and the 15% credit, and (4) includes indemnity language consistent with standard Private offering. Finance should confirm recognizing the credit against the ARR milestone.

Kimberly — you have the green light to offer the approved package to Elena and ask for confirmation on the masked telemetry approach. Jordan — please triage legal redlines; loop in finance.

Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
